page.overview:
Who is An Owl of Luck?

An Owl of Luck is a character version of the card, "An Owl of Luck".

An Owl of Luck appears in the video game, Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship 2007. It appears as a Level One Theme Duelist and it challenges the player to achieve 5 or more Field Spell Cards during a duel. By beating it, the player gets closer to unlocking Level Two Theme Duelists and a new Booster Pack.

In World Championship 2007, An Owl of Luck plays a "Gravekeeper's" Deck titled, "The Gravekeepers".
